candidates.name: lingual thyroid

candidates.why: The location and description of the lesion are consistent with a lingual thyroid.

candidates.name: hamartoma

candidates.why: The benign and disorganized growth of the lesion is consistent with a hamartoma.

candidates.name: lipoma

candidates.why: An MRI or biopsy would be decisive in confirming a lipoma.
